senses.gloss:
Mhālugi
son of Vāsudeva. ref. to by Divākara in his C. Gaṇitatattvacintāmaṇi on his Jātakapaddhati, BBRAS. 357; q. by Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa in his C. Mārtaṇḍavallabhā on his own work Muhūrtamārtaṇḍa, BBRAS. 321 (composed in 1573 A. D.).
--Jātakapaddhati. jy. Bikaner 4624. Dāhilakṣmī XXXIII. 11. Luck. Uni. p. 39. SB. New D.. IX. 36645 (inc.).
